acceptance_repairs.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable route-transition definitions are loaded by the replay evaluator, including the required post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for each applicable transition.
acceptance_repairs.when: The evaluator executes every applicable route transition for every manifest entry and records each transition result.
acceptance_repairs.then: All applicable route transitions complete with no skipped or incomplete transition, and each completed transition includes its post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation, yielding 100% completion for the manifest.

oracle.observable: A machine-readable route-transition result contains one completed record for each manifest entry and applicable transition, including the post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; completion count equals the total applicable transition count.
oracle.expected: Every applicable route transition is executed and reported complete, with a post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation recorded for each transition.
forbidden: Any applicable route transition is skipped or incomplete.
Any transition result lacks its post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation.
The reported completion is below 100% or cannot be reconciled to the complete manifest.
